target_customer: Fashion, beauty, accessories, sport and home retail and consumer brands, moving from luxury to mid-market
problem: Retailers make thousands of stock, pricing and reorder decisions daily using spreadsheets or legacy systems. autone ingests their data, recommends actions and lets users approve them.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for inventory planning modules (buying, rebalancing, allocation, replenishment)
product_category: AI inventory and merchandise planning software for retail

founders.name: Adil Bouhdadi
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked in retail across luxury fashion companies in Paris, New York and London; companies not named.

founders.name: Harry Glucksmann-Cheslaw
founders.background_notes: FashionUnited says he previously built Alexander McQueen's intelligence platform. Education not found.

competitors.name: Nextail
competitors.what: Cloud retail stock allocation and replenishment software built on fast fashion paradigms

competitors.name: Lokad
competitors.what: Quantitative supply chain optimization software including fashion and retail

competitors.name: Excel spreadsheets and legacy systems
competitors.what: Incumbent workflow named by the YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Demand forecasting plus data ingestion from varied retailer systems and a decision workflow is standard engineering with hard data integration.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration into retailer data and planning workflows creates lock-in, but several planning vendors already existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources. autone raised a Series A in October 2024.

market_need_then: YC page says retailers use Excel or legacy systems that are no longer fit for purpose. Founders came out of luxury fashion retail operations.

branding.domain_note: Uses autone.io, not a .com; history not found.

identity.visual_style: Deep blue twilight imagery, customer portraits, clean UI screenshots
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and optimistic, retail wording, 'Success is back in stock', 'glass box, not a black box'

brand_strength.rationale: Coherent retail focused voice on the company site and strong customer testimonials, but no outside press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: autone, founded by retail operators from luxury fashion, raised a $4.5M seed in October 2023 and a $17M Series A led by General Catalyst in October 2024, with more than 50 brands as customers including Roberto Cavalli and Stussy. Its edge was founder market fit and replacing spreadsheets, and it grew from luxury to mid-market retail. No later round was found.
notes: Founding year is 2020 on the founder bio and 2021 on press. Seed reported as $4.5M (ain.ua) and about 4.2M euros (Silicon Canals); an aggregator says $3M, which is unverified. Total raised varies by source ($20M to $23.95M). Competitor sources are undated vendor and comparison pages, not dated to the batch. Education not found. No Series B found in searches.
